channel.title: Light News
channel.description: Positive, lighthearted and unusual current news.

item.title: Celine Dion returns to the stage in Paris
item.description: Celine Dion returns to the stage Saturday for her first full concert in six years, opening a sold-out Paris residency after stiff person syndrome sidelined her career. Paris welcomed her with decorated metro stops, a merchandise pop-up and a giant karaoke event.

item.title: Mastodon tooth turns up in a California creek
item.description: Geomorphologist Brigid Lynch spotted a nine-inch Pacific mastodon tooth sitting half in, half out of a Bay Area creek while working on frog-habitat restoration. The unusually intact fossil, complete with crown and root, will be studied at Stanford and copied in 3D for public education.

item.title: Costa Rican man, 119, seeks world's-oldest recognition
item.description: Jose Flores of Costa Rica is seeking recognition as the world's oldest living person at 119. The former farmworker still jokes and arm-wrestles with his granddaughter in the Nicoya Peninsula, a longevity hot spot. His family and researchers are assembling birth, baptism and other records for verification.
